en.headline: Customs seizes 216 live turtles and two eggs at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: A 52-year-old local driver was arrested after officers found the animals in the boot of an outgoing private car; the haul is valued at about HK$21,800.
body: Hong Kong Customs announced on Tuesday that it had seized 216 live turtles and two turtle eggs with an estimated market value of about HK$21,800 from a cross-boundary private car at the Shenzhen Bay Control Point.

Through risk assessment, officers intercepted the outgoing vehicle on 14 July. The batch of live turtles and eggs was found in the boot. A 52-year-old local male driver was arrested and later released on bail pending further investigation.

Customs said it would continue to combat cross-boundary smuggling activities with firm enforcement action based on risk assessment and intelligence analysis. Under the Import and Export Ordinance, any person found guilty of importing or exporting unmanifested cargo is liable to a maximum fine of HK$2 million and imprisonment for seven years.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲216隻活龜及兩枚龜蛋
zh.dek: 一名52歲本地男司機被截查後在私家車尾箱發現動物，估計市值約2.18萬元，男子已獲准保釋候查。
body: 香港海關星期二公布，於深圳灣管制站一輛出境私家車檢獲216隻活龜及兩枚龜蛋，估計市值約2.18萬元。
海關透過風險評估於7月14日截查該出境私家車，在車尾箱發現該批活龜及龜蛋。一名52歲本地男司機被捕，其後獲准保釋，案件仍在調查中。
海關表示會繼續根據風險評估及情報分析，嚴厲打擊跨境走私活動。根據《進出口條例》，任何人進口或出口未列艙單貨物，一經定罪，最高可被罰款200萬元及監禁七年。
